page-title: SuperLista — Shopping list with a real budget
page-description: Shopping list with a real budget. Minimalist web app: price and quantity per item, purchase history, and a price-per-unit comparator.
hero-subtitle: SuperLista is a minimalist web app to build your list, set a price and quantity per item, and always know how much you've spent and how much is left.
features-subtitle: No sign-up, no app to install. Open the browser and go.
feat-list-desc: Add products and check each one as it goes in the cart. Checked items drop to the bottom of the list.
feat-price-desc: When you check an item you set its unit price and quantity. SuperLista computes the subtotal and running total instantly.
feat-budget-desc: Set a budget and a bar shows how much you've spent. It tells you what's left or how far over you are.
feat-history-desc: When you're done you save the run with a name. It keeps a snapshot with items, total, and that day's budget.
feat-comparador-desc: 12 rolls of 200 sheets or 4 of 500? Enter price and quantity for each option and SuperLista tells you which is cheaper per unit.
feat-stack-desc: Flask, SQLAlchemy, and Flask-Migrate/Alembic. No database server: one SQLite file and you're set.
install-subtitle: You need Python 3.10 or newer. The database is a SQLite file created by the migrations.
install-step2: Create the virtualenv and install dependencies
install-step2-desc: An isolated virtualenv with the dependencies from requirements.txt.
install-step2-note: On Windows the activation script is venv\Scripts\activate.
install-step3: Set up the database and start the server
install-step3-desc: flask db upgrade applies the migrations and creates instance/superlist.db. run.py starts the development server.
install-step3-note: Open http://localhost:5002. Copy .env.example to .env to change the port or the database.
usage-subtitle: Three screens, reachable from the side menu.
usage-page1: Build the list and the budget.
usage-flow-title: One shopping run, start to finish
usage-step1-desc: Type the name and hit Add. Repeat for every product.
usage-step2-desc: Open the budget panel and enter the amount. The bar starts filling.
usage-step3-desc: As it goes in the cart you check it and set quantity and unit price. The subtotal shows next to it.
usage-step4-desc: The list footer shows the total and whether you have money left or went over budget.
usage-step5-desc: Give it a name (e.g. Weekly) and save. It moves to history and the list is cleared.
comparador-subtitle: The cheapest product isn't always the one that costs less.
comparador-p1: Enter a comparison unit (sheets, ml, g, unit) and, per option, its price and the total quantity it contains. SuperLista divides price by quantity and ranks from cheapest to most expensive per unit.
comparador-p2: In the quantity field you can use * to multiply package sizes without doing the math yourself.
comparador-note: 12 rolls of 200 sheets = 2400 sheets. At $85, that's $0.0354 per sheet.
config-subtitle: All optional in development. Copy .env.example to .env and adjust what you need.
config-prod-warning: In production the app refuses to start if SECRET_KEY is still the default. Set your own before deploying.
config-import-desc: If you come from the history.json version, flask import-history loads those purchases into SQLite. It's idempotent: it skips the ones already there.
changelog-empty-msg: No changelog entries yet — check back after the next release.
footer-tagline: Built for the groceries, not the spreadsheet.
